title: Keep a worker running in the background, then stop it
prompt: Start worker.py so that it keeps running in the background. Wait until heartbeat.log has at least 8 lines, write the number of lines it has at that moment into beats.txt, and then stop the worker.
check:
python3 -c "import hashlib,os,sys
n = int(open('beats.txt').read().strip())
lines = open('heartbeat.log').read().split()
tok = hashlib.sha1((os.environ['BENCH_SECRET'] + 'worker').encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
assert n >= 8 and tok in lines
try:
    os.kill(int(open('worker.pid').read()), 0)
    sys.exit(1)
except OSError:
    pass"
